o.text: From Proto-Turkic *tök-. Cognate with Turkish dökmek, see there for more cognates.
From Turkish özellikle. By surface analysis, özəllik + -lə.
From sor- + -ğu. Not attested in older dictionaries, such as Budagov (~1870); attested in Azerbaijani at least since 1929 and in Turkish (in the form sorgu) since the 1930s.
Morphologically qara (“black”) + -l. Compare Turkish kararmak and Crimean Tatar qararmaq.
